text: Guangzhou, China Southern 304. Flaps and slats are jammed. We can't extend beyond 1-5. Request divert to Zhuhai Airport, which has a longer runway. China Southern 304. Clear to Zhuhai. I'll inform Zhuhai you have a configuration problem. Question. What does the crew intend to do?
